description:
## Goal

Make identity-preserving `Types` operations return their existing `Ty` before they allocate a `Descr`, normalize its outer DNF, or probe the interner. The type boundary remains the one and only authority that mints a changed type.

## Evidence

On `fixtures2/behavior/enum_take_drop_split.fz`, the cold AOT trace observed 7,198 pre-normalization index misses for 1,036 inserted descriptors. The current profiler places `Descr` hashing, `Types::intern`, tuple normalization, and emptiness checks on the hot semantic path. Every structural child is already a `Ty`; this task removes needless outer-descriptor construction where an operation can prove its result is an existing handle, rather than adding a raw-descriptor cache.

## Design

Audit public type constructors and transforms. Each must either return an input/canonical constant by construction, or build the smallest genuinely changed descriptor and pass it once to `Types::intern`. Do not add a second type cache, content hash, raw `Ty` order, renderer equivalence check, arena sweep, or a new normalization authority. Preserve the existing index-before-normalization fast path for changed descriptors.

## TDD / signal

First pin representative no-op transforms (including same-id union and a transform whose rebuilt descriptor is unchanged): they return the original `Ty` and do not grow the arena. Add a test-only interning-work census that distinguishes descriptor construction/lookup from new ids, and prove the no-op paths perform neither descriptor interning nor normalization. Retain construction-order, semantic equivalence, and canonical artifact coverage. Measure the enum fixture before/after through the existing telemetry/profile workflow; record work counts, not wall time, as the acceptance signal.

## Deletion / acceptance

Delete the redundant rebuild/probe path each proven no-op replaces. Update `.agent/docs/type-world.md` with the ownership rule. Focused kernel tests, type canon census, the fixture matrix, formatting, `cargo check`, and strict Clippy pass. One commit and a fresh cold review precede close.
title: Preserve Ty identity through no-op type operations
